clauses: This distinguished economist and university teacher made significant contributions to the field of economics.
Throughout their career, they held the position of president and received numerous prestigious honors, including the Adam Smith Award, the John Bates Clark Medal, and the Fisher-Schultz Lecture.
They were also recognized as a Distinguished Fellow of the American Economic Association and a Fellow of the Econometric Society.
Despite their profound impact on the field, they were never awarded the Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
